operation.source_intent: Render the authoritative WordPress site URL as both the visible anchor text and the external anchor target.

laravel_runtime.backend_mapping: SiteManagementService maps site_url directly from the tenant-owned Site url
laravel_runtime.rendering: The Sites DataTable explicitly includes site_url and renders a target=_blank rel=noopener anchor whose href and visible text are the same authoritative value.

state_and_security.blank_url_behavior: renders the existing deterministic em dash formatter and does not synthesize an anchor
state_and_security.loading_error_authority: inherits the existing guarded Sites ResourceContent query loading and error states
state_and_security.tenant_isolation: the Sites workspace remains tenant.view + sites.view gated; foreign tenant access returns 404

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and source semantics
authoritative site_url is visible anchor text and href
production operation marker on the real Sites URL anchor
single authoritative GET with no extra link request or mutation
blank authoritative URL does not synthesize a fake link
